ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to Food Science & Human Nutrition majors on Monday, November 16, 2015 and to business minors on Monday, November 23, 2015 at approximately 9:00 a.m. This will open to Technical Systems Management students on Monday, November 30, 2015 at approximately 9:00 a.m. There are currently 20 reserved seats for College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 22, 2016 at approximately 9:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
